name: Sales Register Aggregation
purpose: Generates summary metrics for sales register report
sql: SELECT count(*)::int as count, sum("taxableAmount") as taxable, sum("totalAmount") as total FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "status" != 'DRAFT'

name: Sales Register Invoices Fetch
purpose: Fetches detailed invoice list for sales register export
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "status" != 'DRAFT' ORDER BY "postedAt" DESC

name: GSTR-1 Outward Supplies Aggregation
purpose: Aggregates intra/inter-state supplies for GST outward report
sql: SELECT "deliveryStateSnapshot", count(*)::int, sum("taxableAmount"), sum("cgstAmount"), sum("sgstAmount"), sum("igstAmount") FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "status" != 'DRAFT' GROUP BY "deliveryStateSnapshot"

name: Stock Summary Item Master
purpose: Fetches inventory items and balances for stock valuation
sql: SELECT "id", "sku", "name", "currentStock", "weightedAverageCost" FROM "inventory_item" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "isActive" = true

name: Stock Movement Ledger By Item (100k Table)
purpose: Fetches movement history for item ledger card
sql: SELECT * FROM "stock_movement" WHERE "inventoryItemId" = 'cmwnfua14000e3mabrdkopcsz' ORDER BY "postedAt" DESC

name: Stock Movement Sum & Count Aggregation (100k Table)
purpose: Cross-checks ledger movements against currentStock balance
sql: SELECT "inventoryItemId", sum("quantity") as total_qty, count(*)::int as movement_count FROM "stock_movement" WHERE "inventoryItemId" = 'cmwnfua14000e3mabrdkopcsz' GROUP BY "inventoryItemId"

name: ATP Check Active Stock Reservations
purpose: Calculates Available-to-Promise stock deduction
sql: SELECT coalesce(sum("reservedQuantity" - "releasedQuantity"), 0) as active_reserved FROM "stock_reservation" WHERE "inventoryItemId" = 'cmwnfua14000e3mabrdkopcsz' AND "warehouseId" = 'cmwnfu9zy00023mab22cjz2ww' AND "status" = 'ACTIVE'

name: Sales Orders List (Admin View - 10k Orders)
purpose: Admin orders list view unpaginated
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_order" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC

name: Sales Orders Filtered by Status (10k Orders)
purpose: Filters approved orders for dispatch scheduling
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_order" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "status" = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC

name: Sales Orders by Salesman (Field Sales)
purpose: Salesman field order list
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_order" WHERE "salesmanId" = 'mHVJCLbgKekSFFVY9aq81JbCEE56qdlc' AND "status" = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC

name: Sales Order Lines By Order ID
purpose: Fetches lines for an order detail or approval modal
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_order_line" WHERE "salesOrderId" = 'so-scale-1'

name: Sales Invoices List (Admin View - 5k Invoices)
purpose: Admin invoices list view unpaginated
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' ORDER BY "postedAt" DESC

name: Customer Invoices List (5k Invoices)
purpose: Customer billing history
sql: SELECT * FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "customerId" = 'cmwnfua0m00093mabuugfbvmy' AND "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' ORDER BY "postedAt" DESC

name: FIFO Allocation - Open Invoices (5k Invoices)
purpose: Identifies oldest open invoices for FIFO payment allocation
sql: SELECT "id", "invoiceNumber", "totalAmount", "paidAmount", "outstandingAmount", "postedAt" FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "customerId" = 'cmwnfua0m00093mabuugfbvmy' AND "outstandingAmount" > 0 AND "status" IN ('POSTED', 'PARTIALLY_PAID') ORDER BY "postedAt" ASC

name: Customer Payment Allocations Join
purpose: Fetches historical allocations for customer receivables ledger
sql: SELECT pa.* FROM "payment_allocation" pa JOIN "sales_invoice" si ON pa."salesInvoiceId" = si."id" WHERE si."customerId" = 'cmwnfua0m00093mabuugfbvmy'

name: Collections Register Payments Query
purpose: Collections register report list
sql: SELECT "id", "paymentNumber", "amount", "unallocatedAmount", "paymentMode", "paymentDate" FROM "payment" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "status" = 'POSTED' ORDER BY "paymentDate" DESC

name: Receivables Overdue Invoices Query (5k Invoices)
purpose: Receivables aging buckets calculation
sql: SELECT "id", "customerId", "outstandingAmount", "postedAt", "dueDate" FROM "sales_invoice" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' AND "outstandingAmount" > 0 AND "status" != 'DRAFT'

name: Production Runs List
purpose: Floor production runs history
sql: SELECT * FROM "production_run" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC

name: Dispatches List with Organization Filter
purpose: Dispatch tracking list
sql: SELECT * FROM "dispatch" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' ORDER BY "dispatchedAt" DESC

name: Audit Log Paginated Query
purpose: System audit log inspection
sql: SELECT * FROM "audit_log" WHERE "organizationId" = 'cmwnfu9g300003mabr2uqrelp' ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 100
